name: Budget-Impact Maintenance Staffing / Resource Recommendations
description: Recommendations on added or changed staff or resources with budgetary impact, raised early enough for inclusion in budget development.
deadline: as soon as is practicable, in time for the budget development process
quote: The Director of Facilities and Maintenance shall ensure that any recommendations regarding additional or the changed utilization of staff or other resources that will have a budgetary impact are brought to the attention of the Board as soon as is practicable in order to ensure appropriate inclusion in the budget development process.
